headline: Approved an intradepartmental budget transfer to pay an outstanding Laurel View water bill, passing unanimously.
summary: The committee received an update on the audit process, including information gathering on 2023. Bank statements requested from Webster Bank were expected by the end of the week. The committee approved a budget transfer to pay the Laurel View water bill for the building and the golf course grounds.
decisions: Approved the intradepartmental transfer in the 2025-2026 fiscal year budget for the Finance Purchasing Division, 0 opposed and 0 abstentions.

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
FINANCE COMMITTEE 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Committee Chair: 
 Present - Jeron Alston 
Committee Vice Chair: 
Absent - Rhonda Caldwell 
Committee Members: 
Present - Ted Stevens 
 Present - Tom Figlar 
Present - Tasha Hunt 
Absent - Grace Teodosio 
Present - Abdul Osmanu 
Present - Sarah Gallagher, Majority Leader 
Absent - Bob Anthony, Minority Leader 
Absent - Katie Kiely, President 
   
 
1. CALL OF THE MEETING AND TAKING OF THE ROLL 
Finance Committee Meeting, September 14, 2026 – 7:00pm.  The meeting was called to 
order at 8:30pm with the members noted above in attendance.   
2. PUBLIC INPUT SESSION 
No one came forward to give public comment. 
    
3. REPORT OF DEPARTMENTS, BOARDS, AND COMMISSIONS 
Information on upcoming Boards/Commission meetings including the Board of 
Assessment Appeals Motor Vehicle Assessment Appeals was shared.  There were no 
other Board, Commission or Department updates for this evening’s meeting. 
  
4. COMMITTEE REGULAR AGENDA  
  1. Information Item: Audit Meeting 
Chair Alston and Director of Finance Hul provided a brief update on the Audit process 
noting that information gathering relating to 2023 was on going.  Director Hul also 
noted that copies of bank statements requested from Webster Bank were to be 
received by the end of the week. 
  
  2. ORDER AUTHORIZING INTRADEPARTMENTAL TRANSFER 2025 - 2026 FISCAL 
YEAR BUDGET – FINANCE – PURCHASING DIVISION  
Motion to open item 4.2 was made by Council member Figlar and seconded by Chair 
Alston. 
Director Hul provided a brief overview stating that the transfer was necessary to pay 
an outstanding water bill for Laurel View for both the building and the grounds (golf 
course).  He noted the cost for water is a conservative estimate and that conditions, 
such as the amount of rain, which would dictate the amount of watering required, 
could cause the estimate to be low.  Director Hul noted that the source of the funds is 
within procurement from a scrape of procurement accounts at the end of the year and 
it is coming to Council because of the dollar threshold of $40,000. 
Vote: All in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.  Item 4.2 passes unanimously.
5. COMMITTEE NEW BUSINESS  
6. COMMITTEE UNFINISHED BUSINESS  
7. ADJOURN 
With no additional business before the Committee, Chair Alston adjourned the meeting at 
8:39pm.
